hc_parade: High Charity. Bells ring across the roofs, and every street has gone quiet.
Guest. The street is closed. Stand at the back.
The President speaks at the Court. Citizens will attend.
Citizen. The street is closed. Step back.

hc_parade_hill: [PLACEHOLDER] Muster Road is still packed. The guards push in again.
Citizens. Glimmerwell has crossed every line we drew. We will not wait for the next one.
From today, the national draft returns. Every able citizen will answer the roll.
Picking Day is closed to civilians. No civilian may pick a Walkling.
Our schools will teach again from the first page. Every lesson will serve the lantern.
Anyone who stands with Glimmerwell in public will be fined or jailed.

hc_gov_meet: Warden Ilse's new Cadet. Don't sit. You won't be here long enough to need a chair.
I've work for you. Kilnmouth's springs have gone cold this season. Nobody there can tell me why.
A Calm Tower went up there the same season. Its permit is in order. I checked it myself.
And their council has an empty seat. Everyone has a name for it. I'd like the town's.
Go and look. Listen more than you talk. Then come back and tell me what you found.
You know where Fernbrook's Seals went.
You tell him about the crate ledger: LAMP STOCK, from the Fernbrook allotment. By permit.
Lamp stock. My office signs a hundred permits a week. I'll ask. Kindly, but I'll ask.
You've the look of someone holding something back. Keep it, then. Bring it when it's ready.
